subject: Guest Pitch: EU vs Silicon Valley funding trends in AI
body:
Hi TNW Tips Desk,

I’m reaching out from the editorial team at TECHi.com. We love TNW’s coverage of the European startup ecosystem and early-stage tech investments.

We recently compiled a data-heavy analysis comparing Q3 funding rounds for generative AI startups in the EU versus Silicon Valley. We believe this would make an excellent guest feature for your audience, providing fresh, non-promotional insights into where tech capital is actually flowing.

Would you be open to reviewing a draft or an outline for a potential guest post?

Best regards,
Rizwan
Partnerships, TECHi.com

subject: Syndication and cross-publishing partnership with TECHi.com
body:
